summary: Flood time steps are built. On Command's river-level chart and Forensic's dock, Play / Pause and Previous / Next buttons (and Space, comma, full stop) move the time handle from step to step: each usable satellite pass (its own date and age, how much of the area it did not see) and each NWS product change that changes the map (issued, new area, cancelled, upgraded, its own end time; the same polygon in the IEM archive copy and NWS's live copy, starting at another vertex, is not a change). The step is labelled ('Satellite pass Oct 25, 11:44 CDT · 11 days before now', 'NWS Flood Warning issued Nov 4, 16:30 CST' with the event name verbatim), and between passes a note says which image the map shows and the gap ('No satellite image between Oct 30 and Nov 1', with the passes in the gap that saw nothing). The 2D map follows the handle: the satellite layer shows that pass's own image (no-view hatch, image edge, its date in the legend chip), nothing before the first pass (said, never an all-clear), and the NWS warning areas of that time from the timeline's versions (archived ones included); at and after now everything is brief 5's. Nothing is drawn between passes. No autoplay; Play stops at the latest step; under reduced motion each press shows one step. While stepping the chart's axis starts at the first step (back to 72 h at now). The shared pure helper state/floodTimeline.ts (keyframes, passAt, productsAt, step, labels) and the timeline store were pushed first (M1) for web-forensic-flood-3d, which uses them.

known_issues: Review fixes (review6): the readout and point card now follow the handle (NWS versions and the pass the map draws); Public always shows now (entering Public puts the handle back at now); see review6-web-flood-playback.json.

The NWS forecast flooded area, FEMA, NWS category maps and the model layers are products of now: at a past step they stay drawn, and their Command chips say 'now' (the forecast area with its issue day) and the slim chart's row says 'As of now, not this time: …'.
Forensic's own foot credits (not this role's files) do not add the IEM archive's credit while its 3D warning lines draw archived versions; the dock's 'NWS · n' list carries the tag, link and credit.
'Official now' (right column) lists the products in effect now, by design; the NWS versions of a past step are on the map and in the step label only.
Play stops at the latest step, not at now: Next (or NOW) returns to now, where the chart's axis goes back to 72 h.
While stepping, the axis can span up to 45 days (St Johns: 40 days), so the recent 72 h take less width; it returns to 72 h at now.
NASA's catalogue lists passes 2-4 days after the overpass (backend note), so the newest days of a live flood often have no step yet; the gap note says 'No satellite image after <date> yet'.
The orchestrator's wave-2 snapshot commit ee6ac13 carried part of M2 and M3 mid-step; the milestone commits contain the rest.
